messages.subject: Auto scroll in RStudio server
parts:
Recently whenever I try to open scripts on the RStudio server <http://spark.rstudio.com:8787/> to work on them the page keep scrolling to the beginning of the scripts. I am using Chrome. 
Any idea how to fix that?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Auto scroll in RStudio server
parts:
The RStudio devs inform me that this is a rare but known bug that we don't have a fix for yet.

Just out of curiousity--can you try in an Incognito window and see if it still happens? I wonder if this could be down to some weird incompatibility with a Chrome extension, and Incognito mode disables all extensions AFAIK.
